name: characterize-refactor
summary: For refactors of old code. Lock the current behavior with tests first, then change the structure in small steps.

roles.name: characterizer
roles.job: Writes tests that record what the code does now, including strange behavior.

roles.name: refactorer
roles.job: Changes the structure of the code in small steps. Runs the tests after each step.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.job: Checks that no behavior changed, except the requested changes.

steps.do: List each rule and each strange case in the old code. Write a test for each one. All tests must pass on the OLD code.
Refactor in small steps. Keep all tests green. Then add the requested new behavior with tests.
Compare old and new code rule by rule. Compare outputs on many generated inputs. Report any difference.

rules: Do not change behavior and structure in the same step.
Keep strange old behavior unless the request says to change it.
